topology_reasoning: The target is a symmetric dual-arm interferometric/coupler-style device made from two long constant-width strip waveguides. Each arm is a smooth S-bend/cosine-like path that spans the full 18 um footprint and remains vertically mirrored about the 1.5 um midline. The arms are widest apart near the ends and closest together near the center. Function-defining knobs are the guide width, the edge-to-center gap profile, and a one-arm delta_length knob that changes real geometry for response verification.
